meta.topStoryHeadline: Kennedy Center Board Votes Again to Shut Main Building Down, and Add Trump's Name Back
meta.topStorySummary: Board voted to close the Kennedy Center for two years of renovation and restore Trump's name, following a judge's earlier order removing it.
executiveSummary: This week’s briefing follows continued pressure on national cultural institutions, including the Kennedy Center board vote to close the main building for two years and restore Trump’s name.
Federal funding and access remain central themes, from the HBCU Arts Act to NMAAHC’s upcoming tenth-anniversary celebration.

Black arts stories to watch include Dallas Black Dance Theatre’s first union contract, Angelica Chéri’s historic Broadway milestone, Marlon James’s Booker Prize longlisting, and new exhibitions and performances across New York.
